definitions.full: H7324. ruq [ רִיק ] verb Hiph`il make empty, empty out (Arabic () pour out, forth , intransitive (of water, blood, etc.); Aramaic רִיק empty, pour , in derivatives; Assyrian rê‡u , empty ); — Perfect 1singular הֲרִי֫קֹתִי Lev 26:33 ; Mal 3:10 ; 3 plural חֵרִיקוּ Ezek 28:7 ; 30:11 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יָרִיק Hab 1:17 , וַיָּ֫רֶק Gen 14:14 (but see below); Imperative masculine singular הָרֵק Psa 35:8 ; Infinitive construct הָרִיק Isa 32:6 ; Participle plural מְרִיקִים Gen 42:35 ; Zech 4:12 ; — 1 empty vessels Gen 42:35 (E) Jer 48:12 ; keep empty , רָעֵב נֶפֶשׁ לְחֶרִיק Isa 32:6 (i.e. keep hungry). 2 pour out or down , rain Mal 3:10 ; Eccl 11:3 , oil Zech 4:12 . 3 empty out (i.e. draw ) sword (compare Assyrian kakkê ittabbaku [passive], Dl HWB 699 b ) Exod 15:9 (poem), Lev 26:33 (H), Ezek 5:2 , 12 ; 12:14 ; 28:7 ; 30:11 ; probably also Hab 1:17 ( חרבו for חרמוֺ Gie We Now); of lance Psa 35:3 ; compare (several.) חניכיו וירק Gen 14:14 (R) led forth , < Samaritan וַיָּ֫דֶק (Aramaic דּוּק Aph`el look ) i.e. mustered ᵐ5 compare Di and others, ויפקּד Ball. — In Psa 18:43 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Hup-Now Bae read אֲדִקֵּם ; so || 2Sam 22:43 MT; but De Dr < אֲרִיקֵם (see דקק ). Hoph`al be emptied out from vessel : Perfect 3masculine singular הוּרק Jer 48:11 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular תּוּרַק Song 1:3 (al. 3 feminine singular; of ointment, in simile); compare also Amos 6:6 , where Oort מוּרְקֵּי for מִזְרְקֵי .
